WHO IS BOK???

Who is this man Bok, anyway, that he thinks he knows how to draw up a peace plan? Would you believe that anyone would ask that question? It doesn't seem possible, but someone did. In fact, more than one person did and those who ask were intelligent people — leaders of thought in some directions. Yet the Bok peace plan has been discussed in newspapers and magazines for months. It has been discussed by churches, clubs and organizations of all kinds that are trying to make the world better. Maybe you will not believe in the Bok peace plan, but there are few normal people who do not believe in peace and welcome any move that will bring it nearer and nearer. At least do not condemn the plan unheard. Get a copy of it and read it. You can get a copy at the Brooklyn Y. M. C. A.
